knowledgeBases.question: What are your shipping rates?
knowledgeBases.answer: We offer FREE shipping all across India for orders above Rs. 499. For orders below Rs. 499, a flat shipping fee of Rs. 50 is charged.

knowledgeBases.question: Are your soaps safe for children?
knowledgeBases.answer: Yes! Our Vaseegrah Nalangu Maavu soap is made of 100% natural, therapeutic herbs and contains no harsh sulfates or parabens. It is perfectly safe for toddlers and children above 1 year.

knowledgeBases.question: Where are you located?
knowledgeBases.answer: Our manufacturing and warehousing unit is based in Trichy, Tamil Nadu. All orders are packed and shipped directly from our Trichy central warehouse.
